$comment: NOT RENDERED. wave-ci reads only .buildkite/wave-ci.json. This file records every GitHub Actions job (or secret-bearing leg of a ported job) that is parked, with the reason and what unblocks it, so nothing is dropped silently. Classes: publish (deploy-class, waits for Jake to name it), event-bot (waits on the GitHub-event bridge, RUN-231 / wave-ci #132), secret (a main-only step needing a secret name that no allowlist row grants a public repository yet), registry (waits on the self-hosted npm registry, ruling WGL-0928-18). No GH schedule exists in this repository.

parked.reason: Tag-triggered (v*) npm publish with NPM_TOKEN, a live registry verify with WAVE_GATEWAY_API_KEY, a GitHub Release and an SBOM asset (contents: write). Deploy-class; ruling WGL-0928-00 allows public SDK publishing but it is not enabled. The check content already runs on every build: secret-scan = secrets-content-policy, verify = lint + typecheck + test + smoke-install-node-20/22.
parked.blocked_on: Jake names the publish crossing; then main_only, tag-gated steps with a publish credential or OIDC federation

parked.reason: Installs @wave-av/governance from GitHub Packages, which returns 403 (billing) for every install, and needs a packages read credential this public pipeline does not hold. Not worked around.
parked.blocked_on: self-hosted registry (ruling WGL-0928-18), then a governance-enforce step that diffs against the PR merge-base

parked.reason: The last smoke step calls the live gateway with WAVE_GATEWAY_API_KEY. GH skips it without the key; the ported smoke steps always take that skip.
parked.blocked_on: secret decision: WAVE_GATEWAY_API_KEY for a main-only live-smoke step

parked.reason: content-policy.sh checks private repository names only when GUARD_PRIVATE_REPOS is set (an org Actions variable on GH). Here it would be a job secret; the ported secrets-content-policy step runs without it, as a fork PR does on GH.
parked.blocked_on: secret decision: GUARD_PRIVATE_REPOS for a main-only content-policy step

parked.reason: Scans PR, issue, comment and review TEXT read from the GitHub event payload. Buildkite has no such trigger.
Triggered by issues events; uses ISSUE_OPS_PAT, BOT_ISSUE_OPS_APP_ID, BOT_ISSUE_OPS_PRIVATE_KEY.
GitHub merge queue events have no Buildkite equivalent while GitHub's merge queue gates merges.
